# Build Handoff: Session Materials And Q&A
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Result

The local session detail view now has `Session Materials` and `Q&A` tabs. Materials remain protected downloads. Q&A is scoped to the selected session and supports questions, answers, one vote per user on each item, author-owned edit/delete controls, and administrator moderation. Administrator Classroom session actions also expose the existing `Edit session` flow.

The local implementation covers `RQ-21 (Session detail materials and Q&A tabs)` and the related approved material, authorization, permission, and moderation requirements. The Q&A feed now has a fixed maximum height sized for about three normal question cards, while the question form is collapsed by default and opens through `Ask a question`. Gate 1, staging, production, participant-data governance, and launch acceptance remain open.

## Security And Scope

- All Q&A routes remain behind authentication and active-user middleware.
- Draft and archived participant sessions remain inaccessible; administrators retain their existing session visibility.
- Question and answer mutations verify the parent session or question relationship server-side.
- Authors cannot edit or delete another user's content. Administrators can moderate any Q&A content.
- Vote records are unique per user and target item.
- User-provided text is rendered as text, not HTML.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, or real participant data were added.

## Known Limitations

- Search, filtering, advanced sorting, notifications, attachments, and answer nesting beyond one level are not included in this increment.
- The PM confirmed the listed local browser checks on 2026-08-24; formal Measure evidence and the broader acceptance audit remain open.
- Q&A moderation actions are not yet included in the administrative activity log.
- Local SQLite evidence does not replace the deferred Gate 1, staging, or production checks.
